# History

Weftspun3DStudio's character-creator lineage runs through three
earlier projects.

**V1: Atlas Foundation** laid the groundwork, an open and evolving
character creator for the open metaverse
(`github.com/AtlasFoundation/AvatarCreator`).

![](/img/97bDPrd.png)

**V2: Webaverse** shipped a 3D avatar creator for everyone
(`github.com/webaverse-studios/CharacterCreator`), with character
classes, an AI personality generator, and a mint function.

![image](/img/rJ80Rwpja.png)

**V3: M3** carried the fork forward as Anata. Weftspun3DStudio forks
from that line; RFD 0017, in `weftspun/request-for-discussion`,
records the rebrand.

![Screenshot from 2023-12-30 15-53-13](/img/rJzD026jp.png)
